messages:
amelia: Quick Q2 OKR pulse — please reply with one-line: shipped / slipped / next-step (owner). We're compiling an exec summary by EOD. Short answers pls.

Drew: Ridge-search -> shipped to prod yesterday. Canary stable. @raj can you confirm perf numbers? :tada:

Raj: Confirmed. p50 120ms, p95 310ms on dedicated -- KV cache helped. Logs: https://internal/logs/rs/2167

Maria: Latency quantization work -> slipped. Blocked by cuDNN kernel mismatch on our A100 image. Investigating with eng-infra. Next step: temp fallback to int8 profile, owner @maria. PR: https://gh/ri/ci/pulls/4567

Ben: CR ping on @maria's PR — left 2 nits, tests flaky on macos-runner. I can merge after green if no objections. Also we should run perf-suite on dedicated before canary.

Sarah: Storage migration dependency for rollback window — storage team needs the final schema flag. @drew can you confirm EOD Wed works for your timeline?

Drew: EOD Wed works. Migration takes ~30m, low traffic window. Owners: @sarah + @storage-team. Will post runbook in #eng-infra.

deploy-bot: deploy ridge-search v2 -> canary started 2167890200, 5% traffic.

Amelia: great. Action items I have: 1) Raj to post perf snapshot, 2) Maria to land fallback PR + mark owner, 3) Drew/Sarah to run migration Wed, 4) Ben to merge after tests. I'll assemble summary. If you're done, react :white_check_mark:
